Actual Article Body:
September 30, 2026

Trump gave Xi a bald eagle. Xi promised America two pandas. Behind the diplomatic symbolism sits a larger shift: China’s international standing is improving as trust in the United States declines.

President Donald Trump presented a statue of a bald eagle to President Xi Jinping when they met in Washington on 24 September saying that he hoped it would find a “nice place” in Beijing. The gift of an eagle, the national symbol of the USA, was clearly full of meaning, but different people may have different interpretations of the exchange. (By the way, bald eagles are not bald. They have white ‘bald’ heads.)
